Suanzaorentang Ziziphus Soup. Profile Suanzaorentang is a traditional Chinese remedy for anxiety and insomnia. It contains five herbs: suanzaoren (Zizyphus spinosus, Rhamnaceae), fuling (Poria cocos, Polyporaceae), gancao (Gly- cyrrhiza uralensis, Leguminosae), zhimu (Anemarrhena as- phodeloides, Liliaceae), and chuanxiong (Ligusticum chuanx- iong, Umbelliferae). Subtilisin A Subtilisin Carlsberg; Subtilopeptidase A. Субтилизин А CAS — 9014-01-1 (subtilisin). Profile Subtilisins are a class of serine proteases isolated initially from Bacillus subtilis but which are also excreted by other Bacillus species. They are widely used in the manufacture of enzymatic detergents. Hypersensitivity reactions have been reported. Subtilisin A, which is obtained from Bacillus licheniformis, is used as an enzymatic cleanser for contact lenses. ◊ References. 1. Lemiere C, et al. Isolated late asthmatic reaction after exposure to a high-molecular-weight occupational agent, subtilisin. Chest 1996; 110: 823–4.
